text: Native SDKs let apps fetch products, make purchases, and check subscription status
quote: Fetch products, make purchases, and check subscription status with our native SDKs.

text: Products can be hosted and configured remotely from the RevenueCat dashboard
quote: Host and configure products remotely from our dashboard.

text: Real-time subscription events are delivered via webhooks
quote: Get notified of real-time events through webhooks.

text: Entitlements let apps check user access to content without managing product IDs directly
quote: Entitlements are used to ensure a user has appropriate access to content based on their purchases, without having to manage all of the product identifiers in your app code.

text: SDK can check eligibility for introductory offers on iOS to show correct subscription terms
quote: The Purchases SDK allows for easy checking of eligibility for introductory offers on iOS, so that you as the developer can display the proper subscription terms to your customers.

text: CustomerInfo object exposes all purchase and subscription data for a customer
quote: The CustomerInfo object contains all of the purchase and subscription data available about a customer.

text: Existing purchase data can be imported into RevenueCat server-side or client-side
quote: Importing existing purchase data to RevenueCat can be done server-side, or client-side.

text: API keys authenticate requests from the SDK and REST API
quote: RevenueCat authenticates requests from the RevenueCat SDK and the REST API using API keys.

text: Dashboard charts show subscription metrics with filters and segments to understand the user base
quote: RevenueCat charts allow you to understand your user base with key subscription specific metrics, filters, and segments.

text: App data can be delivered on a schedule to cloud storage or email
quote: RevenueCat delivers your apps' data to a cloud storage provider or to email on a schedule you control.

text: Dashboard lets you set up projects, apps, Products, Entitlements, Offerings, and Packages for subscriptions
quote: Set up subscriptions, including projects, apps, Products, Entitlements, Offerings, and Packages

text: An official MCP server lets AI assistants manage subscription apps, Products, and Entitlements without the dashboard
quote: The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.

text: Rico AI assistant answers plain-language questions about subscription data directly
quote: Instead of digging through charts and tables yourself, you can ask Rico plain-language questions like "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?" and get a direct, data-driven answer.

text: Dashboard shows customer transaction histories, lifetime value charts, and lets staff grant promotional subscriptions
quote: See customer transaction histories, chart lifetime value, and grant promotional subscriptions.

text: Remotely configurable paywalls let you control product offering presentation
quote: Paywalls — Remotely configure your product offering with powerful paywalls.
